mapper.select: /** * searchComboBoxAprv : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.WorkChgMngMapper : 승인상태구분코드 조회 */ SELECT AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS CD_VALUE , AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CD_NAME FROM SAC100 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'APRV_STTS_SE_CD' AND AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE IN ('0','2','3')

/** * selectWorkChgMngSms : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.WorkChgMngMapper : 근무변경 일괄 문자발송 조회 */ SELECT T1.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN , T1.CHG_DMND_ID AS CHG_DMND_ID , T1.APRV_STTS_SE_CD AS APRV_STTS_SE_CD , T1.SMS_SNDNG_YN AS SMS_SNDNG_YN , '청소년상담-근무변경신청결과' AS MSG_SUBJECT , ( SELECT REPLACE( A1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE3, '{time}', substr(T1.CHG_DMND_WORK_YMD, 0, 4) || '-' || substr(T1.CHG_DMND_WORK_YMD, 5, 2) || '-' || substr(T1.CHG_DMND_WORK_YMD, 7, 2) ) FROM SAC100 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CHRCTR_ATMTC_SNDNG_SE_CD' AND A1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = DECODE(T1.APRV_STTS_SE_CD,'2','01','3','02') ) AS DEMAND_MSG_CONTENTS , C##RG.DEC_B64(T3.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS DEMAND_CALL_TO , ( SELECT REPLACE( A1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE3, '{time}', substr(T1.CHG_TRGT_WORK_YMD, 0, 4) || '-' || substr(T1.CHG_TRGT_WORK_YMD, 5, 2) || '-' || substr(T1.CHG_TRGT_WORK_YMD, 7, 2) ) FROM SAC100 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CHRCTR_ATMTC_SNDNG_SE_CD' AND A1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = DECODE(T1.APRV_STTS_SE_CD,'2','01','3','02') ) AS TARGET_MSG_CONTENTS , C##RG.DEC_B64(T5.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS TARGET_CALL_TO FROM AYC140 T1 , SAA200 T2 , SCA100 T3 , SAA200 T4 , SCA100 T5 WHERE 1=1 AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T1.SMS_SNDNG_YN = 'N' AND T1.APRV_STTS_SE_CD IN ('2','3') AND T1.CHG_DMND_ID = T2.USER_ID AND T2.ENFSN_NO = T3.ENFSN_NO AND T1.CHG_TRGT_ID = T4.USER_ID AND T4.ENFSN_NO = T5.ENFSN_NO
AND T1.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{bgngYmd} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND T1.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{endYmd} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1

SELECT ISRY_SMS.MMS_CONTENTS_INFO_SEQ.CURRVAL AS CONT_SEQ FROM DUAL
/** * processWorkChgMngSms1 : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.WorkChgMngMapper : 근무변경 일괄 문자발송 등록1 */ INSERT INTO ISRY_SMS.MMS_CONTENTS_INFO ( CONT_SEQ , FILE_CNT , MMS_SUBJECT , MMS_BODY ) VALUES ( ISRY_SMS.MMS_CONTENTS_INFO_SEQ.NEXTVAL , '1' , #{MSG_SUBJECT} , #{MSG_CONTENTS} )

/** * processWorkChgMngSms2 : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.WorkChgMngMapper : 근무변경 일괄 문자발송 등록2 */ INSERT INTO ISRY_SMS.MSG_DATA ( MSG_SEQ , REQ_DATE , CUR_STATE , CALL_TO , CALL_FROM , MSG_TYPE , USER_ID , CONT_SEQ ) VALUES ( ISRY_SMS.MSG_DATA_SEQ.NEXTVAL , SYSDATE , '0' , #{CALL_TO} , '0516623229' , '6' , #{loginId} , #{CONT_SEQ} )
mapper.update: /** * processWorkChgMngSms3 : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.WorkChgMngMapper : 근무변경 일괄 문자발송 수정3 */ UPDATE AYC140 AA /**근무변경허가원**/ SET AA.SMS_SNDNG_YN = 'Y' , AA.SNDNG_DT = SYSDATE , AA.LAST_MDFR_ID = #{loginId} , AA.LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE 1=1 AND AA.INDEX_SN = #{INDEX_SN}

SELECT AA.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN , AA.CHG_DMND_SN AS SRC_DMND_SN /** 변경요청일련번호 **/ , AA.CHG_TRGT_SN AS SRC_TRGT_SN /** 변경대상일련번호 **/ , AA.CHG_DMND_ID AS DMND_ID /** 요청자아이디 **/ , BB.USER_ID AS TARGET_DMND_ID , BB.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN AS TARGET_DMND_SN , BB.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD AS TARGET_DMND_DEPT_CD , CC.USER_ID AS TARGET_TRGT_ID , CC.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN AS TARGET_TRGT_SN , CC.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD AS TARGET_TRGT_DEPT_CD FROM AYC140 AA , AYC100 BB , AYC100 CC WHERE 1=1 AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AA.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '0' /** 대기(0) 상태인 경우 - 일괄승인 **/ AND BB.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN = AA.CHG_DMND_SN AND CC.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN = AA.CHG_TRGT_SN
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{bgngYmd} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{endYmd} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
